notes: Single source of truth for placeholder images on the 23 service pages. Marketing creates {webp,png,svg} triplets at public/images/hubs/{category}/{filename}.*; build picks them up automatically. Do NOT change filenames without updating consumer page <ImageTextSplit catalogId> calls.

images.alt: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V aerospace bracket machined on a 5-axis CNC center, bright silver swarf, fine coolant mist
images.prompt: Photorealistic industrial B2B photograph. A precision-machined Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V aerospace bracket sits on a 5-axis CNC machining center table. Bright silver titanium swarf curls in the foreground, fine coolant mist hangs in the air, sharp depth of field, studio lighting with soft shadows. The bracket has organic freeform surfaces with thin-wall sections. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people, no logos.

images.alt: Five-axis simultaneous CNC cutting of a titanium turbine blade, showing tool angle and finished profile
images.prompt: Close-up industrial photograph of a 5-axis CNC machining center cutting a titanium turbine blade. Tool head is angled 35 degrees to the workpiece, fresh silver swarf, kinematic tool tip visible, fine chip evacuation. Studio lighting, depth of field on the cutting zone. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Live-tooling mill-turn lathe producing a Grade 5 titanium medical bone screw, bar feeder visible
images.prompt: Industrial photograph of a Swiss-style mill-turn lathe with live tooling cutting a Grade 5 titanium medical bone screw. Bright bar stock feeds from the back, finished parts drop into a chute. Coolant mist, silver swarf, sharp detail on the cutting insert. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Brass-wire EDM cutting a thin-wall titanium aerospace part submerged in deionized water
images.prompt: Photograph inside a wire EDM tank, brass wire cutting through a Grade 5 titanium aerospace component with 0.5 mm wall thickness. Deionized water dielectric visible, fine bubbles rising, spark erosion glow on the cut. Studio lighting through the tank window. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Finished Grade 5 titanium valve and impeller on an inspection bench, blued passivated surface
images.prompt: Top-down photograph of a finished Grade 5 titanium impeller and a chemical-process valve body sitting on a calibrated granite inspection bench. Blued, passivated surfaces, softbox lighting from above, shadowless. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Inside an SLM build chamber, Ti-6Al-4V powder bed with a blue laser trace mid-melt
images.prompt: Photograph inside a selective laser melting (SLM) build chamber. Ti-6Al-4V powder bed visible, blue laser trace mid-scan, recoater blade at the side, inert argon atmosphere haze. Industrial photography, dramatic lighting on the laser spot. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Close-up of fiber laser melting titanium powder layer by layer, recoater visible in frame
images.prompt: Macro photograph of a fiber laser melting Ti-6Al-4V powder layer. Recoater blade depositing fresh powder on the right, melt pool glowing on the left, support structures visible at the build edge. Inert gas haze. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Engineer holding a freshly 3D-printed titanium lattice prototype, unpowdered and supports still attached
images.prompt: A gloved hand holding a freshly built Ti-6Al-4V lattice prototype (aerospace bracket geometry). Loose powder still visible in the cells, support structures attached, soft studio lighting. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text.

images.alt: Batch of 50 finished titanium spinal interbody cages on a QC tray with batch labels
images.prompt: Top-down photograph of 50 finished Grade 23 Ti spinal interbody cages arranged on a stainless QC tray, each with a paper batch label, soft overhead lighting. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Fiber-laser cutting a titanium plate, bright kerf sparks, finished cut parts stacked beside
images.prompt: Industrial photograph of a fiber-laser cutter cutting through a 6 mm Grade 2 titanium plate. Bright kerf sparks falling below, finished cut parts stacked to the right, CNC control screen in the background. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Close-up of fiber-laser nozzle cutting titanium sheet, kerf fumes rising
images.prompt: Macro photograph of a fiber-laser nozzle cutting a 3 mm Ti-6Al-4V sheet. Bright cutting kerf, vaporized metal fumes rising, dross on the underside. Sharp depth of field on the cut zone. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Pure abrasive waterjet cutting a thick titanium plate, garnet stream visible in catch tank
images.prompt: Photograph of a pure abrasive waterjet cutting a 25 mm Grade 5 titanium plate. Garnet abrasive stream visible, water splash in the catch tank, garnet slurry draining. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: TIG welding a titanium pipe in a purged argon enclosure, golden weld bead visible
images.prompt: Photograph of a TIG welding torch laying a golden weld bead on a Grade 2 titanium pipe inside a purged argon enclosure. Argon trailing shield glowing slightly, the weld pool is bright, finished weld shows characteristic straw/gold titanium oxide color. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Hot forging press with a glowing titanium billet, hydraulic ram descending, scale flakes
images.prompt: Industrial photograph of a hot forging press with a glowing orange titanium billet (Grade 5, 950 degrees C) under a hydraulic ram. Black oxide scale flakes falling, dies glowing. Dramatic lighting, heat haze visible. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Open-die forging hammer striking a titanium ingot, scale flakes flying
images.prompt: Industrial photograph of an open-die forging hammer striking a Grade 5 titanium ingot. Black scale flakes flying, dies are heavy steel, hammer ram frozen mid-strike. Dramatic lighting. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Hydraulic extrusion press pushing a heated titanium profile through a die
images.prompt: Industrial photograph of a hydraulic extrusion press pushing a heated Grade 2 titanium billet through a die to form a complex profile. Visible die swell, lubrication residue, hydraulic pressure gauge. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Titanium bar saw cut-off, fine bright chips, length gauge, finished billets stacked
images.prompt: Industrial photograph of a titanium bar saw cut-off operation. A cold saw cutting a Grade 5 titanium round bar, fine bright silver chips, length gauge, finished billets stacked to the side. Coolant dripping. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Anodizing bath of titanium parts, multi-color voltage-graded parts on a rack
images.prompt: Photograph of a titanium anodizing line. A rack of Grade 5 titanium parts submerged in an electrolytic bath, with previously anodized parts hanging in the background showing voltage-graded colors (gold, purple, blue, teal). Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Close-up of titanium screws anodizing in an electrolytic bath, blue and purple parts on rack
images.prompt: Close-up photograph of Grade 5 titanium screws anodizing in an electrolytic bath. Parts on a titanium rack, voltage is mid-cycle showing blue-to-purple gradient. DC power supply in the background. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Titanium parts submerged in a nitric acid passivation tank under a fume hood
images.prompt: Photograph of Grade 5 titanium medical parts submerged in a nitric acid passivation tank inside a fume hood. Slight yellow tint to the bath, parts on a PTFE rack, vapor extraction visible above. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Operator polishing a titanium dive watch case with a buffing wheel, gloved and aproned
images.prompt: A gloved operator in apron polishing a Grade 5 titanium dive watch case on a buffing wheel. Cotton buff with rouge compound, mirror finish visible on the case, soft safety lighting. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Stack of custom-printed titanium parts boxes with brand tape and foam inserts
images.prompt: Top-down photograph of 12 custom-printed corrugated boxes stacked on a pallet, each containing a Grade 5 titanium aerospace part in custom-cut foam. Brand-printed tape sealing the top, shipping labels visible. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.

images.alt: Fiber-laser engraving a corporate logo on a titanium plate, white etching visible
images.prompt: Close-up photograph of a fiber-laser engraver marking a corporate logo on a polished Grade 5 titanium plate. Bright white oxide etch visible, smoke plume rising, finished part beside shows clean logo. Aspect ratio 3:2. No text, no people.
